purpose.summary: EchoVerse Time Circuit release experience: numbered Future's Past audio, archive cuts, timeline artwork, and a Future's Past hoodie-only merchandise store.
purpose.source_of_truth_policy: index.html owns the experience structure; time-circuit.css owns presentation; time-circuit.js owns Time Circuit audio, WebAudio visualization, and view behavior; future-past-store.js owns store rendering and bag policy. store.json is the browser-facing time-circuit destination manifest and may contain canonical avp_* / avv_* identity only. Square/provider IDs remain server-side and NXCore Commerce remains checkout authority.
purpose.business_role: Music-led EchoStory experience with a tightly scoped merchandise capsule.

runtime.entry_command: serve repository root as static files

deployment.networking_notes: Custom domain is declared by the repository-root CNAME and GitHub Pages Enforce HTTPS is enabled. Certificate or DNS propagation can temporarily affect edge reachability without changing the canonical production origin.

release.listen_surface: Time Circuit native visualizer/player layout with WebAudio waveform, frequency bars, DEST/FLUX readout, classic transport, and numbered playlist

catalog_store.ux_reference_scope: store view only; Listen and Archive retain Time Circuit-native presentation
catalog_store.bag_state: local browser presentation state using canonical productId / variantId only
catalog_store.checkout_state: gated until canonical Commerce handoff is explicitly deployed and verified

portfolio.decision_notes: Time Circuit is an EchoStory-class media-rich experience under EchoVerse. Security review 2026-08-04 scanned the current tree and full git history for hardcoded secrets and unsafe code patterns and found no issue; live-deployment status was also checked through GitHub at that time. Portfolio lane was corrected from promote to keep after that review. 2026-09-05: Future's Past is the only merchandise collection allowed on Time Circuit; the browser consumes a destination-scoped canonical manifest rather than the broad Apparel catalog, while TC-02 and TC-03 remain visibly pending until their real masters are added. The production custom domain is time-circuit.aerovista.us and GitHub Pages Enforce HTTPS is enabled. Northline is used only as the Store-tab layout/interaction reference. Listen retains the original Time Circuit visualizer/player identity and Archive remains Time Circuit-native. Northline is not a runtime dependency.

governance.review_cycle: when audio masters, artwork, catalog scope, checkout, experience shell, or deployment changes
governance.update_rule: Update this file whenever a canonical file moves, is replaced, changes purpose, or deploy behavior changes.
governance.promotion_rule: Files are promoted into canon only after review.
governance.archive_rule: Old versions move to archive and are never treated as master files.

notes: Northline store UX is a Store-view presentation reference only; do not apply it to Listen or Archive and do not couple Time Circuit runtime to Northline.
Do not add Square/provider IDs to browser-facing store.json.
